write_up: You lead ledger and settlement work and have a credible path from storage infrastructure to payments. A recruiter can see the architecture decisions and the duplicate-charge problem you addressed. The main question is how much the ledger redesign changed the platform.

The fraud scoring pipeline line is a useful model: it names what you built, the tools, the workload, and the p99 latency. Bring that same specificity to the ledger redesign and reconciliation improvements where you can.
